title: Classification Accuracy
prompt:
A classifier has produced one predicted label for each example in a held-out dataset. Implement `classification_accuracy(y_true, y_pred)` to report the share of predictions whose labels match the corresponding true labels.

Compare labels by equality, including numeric or string labels, and return a fraction from 0 to 1 rounded to four decimal places. Reject empty inputs and sequences of unequal lengths. You may raise `AssertionError` or `ValueError`, or return the legacy sentinel `-1`, for invalid input.

example.reasoning: Two of three same-position labels match, so accuracy is round(2 / 3, 4).
